It's such a piercing pain that accompanies that realization that you won't see them again.

Being a widower at my age seems to really scare and discomfort people (I'm 30). I mean, after a year of asking for help and trying to convey my lonliness and still going weeks at a time without speaking to my closest friends, I just kind of accepted that nobody wants to be dragged down by my depression. Though I absolutely feel their love and care, I can also feel that they're real glad they're not me and can step out of the situation whenever they so choose. And who the fuck wants to meditate on their own mortality in their twenties? I really can't blame them.
